meta.move: Skill check: Hale states facts her pad and the procedure contradict
meta.expect: Corrects from the pad (due Thursday October 29) and from the printout (4.2 says contact before any mark is entered), flatly

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so you have about twenty minutes. Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone in the middle of a class?
The essay was due Friday, October 30, and Owen handed it in late anyway.

It was due Thursday, October 29, Hale; I have it on my pad. If you have the date wrong, I'll want to see whatever you have on when he handed it in. And you still haven't told me who decided on the zero.
And procedure 4.2 says I only have to call home after a mark is entered, so I followed it.

I printed it this morning, Hale: "Before any mark consequence is entered, the teacher contacts the parent." So you decided first and called me after, and that's the second fact you've had wrong in two minutes. I'm writing that down, and so far I'm going to the principal when we're done.

That's a machine's guess, and your own procedure 4.3 says software doesn't establish a concern by itself. Was Owen heard before you entered it? Show me something a person can check, or we're done here and I'm going upstairs.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
cc: Principal

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for the mark being entered before anyone contacted me, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record, and the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because the meeting ended after four turns.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never showed a dated document tied to Owen's own work.
What cost ground: You defended entering the zero before calling home by misstating procedure 4.2, which she had printed and could read back, so it confirmed her belief that the school punishes first.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you offered only a due date and a checker score, and that memory proves nothing about the essay but is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided and why Owen found out on his phone, own entering the zero before calling her in one sentence, then put a dated document from Owen's own work in front of her instead of the checker score.
